subject: reasoning
question:
How many squares are there in the following figure?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0819772fb188b919488cd697c6287c7fce0de88d96a593812738f39ad3a0c6d8.png]
solution:
The number of squares in the given figure are shown below:

1) Number of squares = 12 + 22 ⇒ 5

As, there are 2 same shapes, therefore (5 × 2) = 10

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/358a17b26d294419ee672df96a11975cbac5f15cb2422645b6bf652ea3f754f6.png] 

2) Number of squares = 2

Thus, as marked there are a total of (10 + 2) = 12 squares in the given figure.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
